name: std-algo-gridbfs
description: Grid BFS wavefront — each tick dequeues one open cell and enqueues its non-wall 4-neighbours, expanding toward the target on algorithm-canvas cells.

schema.name: std-algo-gridbfs
schema.description: Grid BFS wavefront — each tick dequeues one open cell and enqueues its non-wall 4-neighbours, expanding toward the target on algorithm-canvas cells.

emits.description: The grid each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

events.name: Cells Updated
events.description: The grid each step — a composed listener can subscribe; a harmless no-op standalone.

startId.label: Start Cell
startId.description: Id (row*cols+col) of the cell BFS starts from.

cells.label: Cells
cells.description: The initial grid; value 0 = open, 1 = wall, 2 = start, 3 = target.

targetId.label: Target Cell
targetId.description: Id (row*cols+col) of the goal; BFS stops when its wavefront reaches it.

running.label: Running
running.description: When true the tick expands the wavefront one cell per step; toggle to start/pause.
